items.hed: Brad Ausmus will be formally introduced as the Astros' next manager at a Daikin Park press conference Friday
items.insight: MLB.com reports general manager Randy Flores called hiring Ausmus, who returns to the organization where he caught two playoff runs as a catcher, the choice he wanted to make. Ausmus spent the past three seasons as the Yankees' bench coach before taking over for Joe Espada, and Friday's introduction at Daikin Park will be his first public appearance in the new role.
items.image_caption: Minute Maid Park (now Daikin Park), 2010. Venue still.

items.hed: The Rockets snapped Golden State's eight-game winning streak with a 115-108 win Wednesday night at Toyota Center
items.insight: The official NBA.com game summary credits Kevin Durant with 20 points and Alperen Sengun and Amen Thompson with 19 apiece as Houston handed the Warriors their first loss in nine games. The win keeps the Rockets near the top of the Western Conference early in the season and gives the home crowd a measuring-stick victory over one of the league's hottest teams.

items.hed: The Texans' Week 10 injury report shows receivers Tank Dell and Marvin Harrison Jr. both limited ahead of Sunday's trip to Cleveland
items.insight: Houston's official injury report lists Dell (hand, shoulder) and Harrison (hamstring) as limited in Wednesday's practice ahead of the 1 p.m. Eastern kickoff at Huntington Bank Field against the Browns. The team enters off an eight-sack defensive performance and a five-touchdown day from C.J. Stroud, so the health of both receivers will matter for whether that complete effort carries into Cleveland.
